put.description: Requires awake computer, Content-Length, and SHA256. Validates the full body before writing. Publishes a same-directory temporary file by atomic rename; partial or mismatched uploads leave the previous file intact. Missing parents return404. Maximum4MiB, two transfers per instance,60second upload and60second execution bounds. A lost response can leave the result uncertain: read and compare SHA256 before retrying. Files stay on this computer's disk and are not shared artifacts.

appBearer.description: A live app sess_ session or oa_sk_ sign-in key. Account-bound oak_ keys are accepted only where the operation declares them and their scopes permit it. API cookies are ignored.

appKeyManagementBearer.description: An account-service-issued live app session (sess_) or sign-in key (oa_sk_). The account service validates it on every request. Cookies and oak_ API keys cannot manage these keys. A sign-in key can create and revoke other sign-in keys for the same account, including itself.

projectManagementBearer.description: A live account-service app session (sess_) or sign-in key (oa_sk_). These web handlers reject cookies alone and oak_ API keys. Every request resolves the account and current project role; knowing an ID does not grant access.

name.description: Sign-in names are trimmed, 1–80 characters, with no control characters. API names are trimmed and truncated to 80 characters; an empty name is refused.

expires_in_days.description: Sign-in keys only. Omitted or null means until revoked. Any non-null expiry with kind=api is refused.

chat.description: An existing chat owned by this account.

version.description: The saved version number, paired with environment.

idempotency_key.description: Required here or in Idempotency-Key; both must match. Keep the key bound to the immutable request after completion or deletion.

files.description: Absent or null means protected file transfer is unsupported. Do not infer support from the backend name.

command.description: Shell command. Do not put credentials in command text.

cwd.description: Existing directory relative to the computer workspace; traversal and symlink escape refuse.

env.description: Non-secret values only. Names: LANG, LC_ALL, TZ, CI, TERM, or OA_PARAM_*; credential fields refuse.

idempotency_key.description: Required here or as Idempotency-Key. Reuse across retries.

name.description: Trimmed, nonempty, at most 100 characters. Omit to use the first repository's name.

instructions.description: At most 8,000 characters after cleaning; blank instructions become null.

repository.description: Older single-repository input; combined with repositories.

repositories.description: Connected GitHub owner/name values; at most 20 distinct repositories.

AppProjectCreate.description: Supply a nonblank name or at least one repository. Unknown fields are ignored. A repository is optional; duplicate project names and reuse of a repository across projects are allowed.

repository.description: Only null is ignored; any other repository field is refused.

name.description: An owner can rename the project. Trimmed and limited to 100 characters.

instructions.description: Omission leaves instructions unchanged; null clears them. Limited to 8,000 characters after cleaning.

primary_repository.description: Choose a repository already attached to this project. Null leaves the primary unchanged.

protection.description: Owner only; a shared project cannot become only_me.

AppProjectEdit.description: Supply at least one change. Unknown fields are ignored, but a non-null older repository field is refused; use the repository routes.

invitations.description: Present only for the owner; does not expose invitation codes.

expires_in.description: Seconds. Missing, null or zero uses seven days; other values clamp to 600–2,592,000 seconds.

github.description: Optional GitHub login to receive an invitation on their Projects page. This lookup needs the configured GitHub service.

AppProjectInvite.description: An absent, non-object or malformed JSON body currently uses the default editor invitation; clients should send an explicit JSON object.

code.description: The invitation code or its full link. Query and fragment suffixes are ignored.
